assessment.nobel_worthiness: Room-temperature tunnel magnetoresistance established a fundamental spin-dependent tunnelling phenomenon and enabled major spintronic technology.
assessment.attribution: The three credited researchers represent the key experimental establishment and technological realization of large room-temperature effects.
assessment.maturity: The effect has been reproduced extensively, is quantitatively understood, and has had durable device impact.
uncertainties: The division of credit between early demonstrations, materials development, and device engineering requires careful historical review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory transformed the quantitative treatment of correlation-driven phenomena in real materials.
assessment.attribution: Georges, Kotliar, and Vollhardt are central architects of the modern framework and its decisive formulation.
assessment.maturity: It is a mature, widely validated theoretical method with extensive connections to measured spectra and material properties.
uncertainties: The contribution is methodological, so its prize framing must distinguish foundational physics from subsequent computational applications.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The quantum spin Hall effect and time-reversal-invariant topological insulators revealed a new robust class of quantum matter.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele supplied the decisive theoretical prediction, while Molenkamp led a landmark experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The underlying topological phase is firmly established and has stimulated a broad experimental field.
uncertainties: Credit must be reconciled with closely related topological-insulator and quantum-anomalous-Hall advances.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magnetic skyrmions made emergent topology and electrodynamics directly observable in magnetic materials.
assessment.attribution: The credited researchers span key theory, bulk experimental discovery, and development of the field in materials and devices.
assessment.maturity: Skyrmion signatures, dynamics, and topology have been independently confirmed across multiple material platforms.
uncertainties: The exact priority and appropriate boundary between discovery, interpretation, and later materials advances need review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks achieved an exceptional advance in frequency metrology and precision tests of physics.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye are the clearly identified pioneers of the lattice-clock concept and its high-performance realization.
assessment.maturity: Independent clocks now demonstrate extraordinary reproducibility and sustained scientific utility.
uncertainties: The final prize wording should delimit the invention from wider optical-clock developments.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Photonic band gaps introduced a powerful physical analogue of electronic band structure and reshaped control of light.
assessment.attribution: John and Yablonovitch made foundational proposals, with Joannopoulos central to the theoretical development of photonic crystals.
assessment.maturity: The concepts are experimentally secure and embedded in modern photonics.
uncertainties: The appropriate balance between conceptual invention, theoretical development, and experimental realization needs scrutiny.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rydberg blockade enabled programmable many-atom quantum systems with unusual reach for simulation and computation.
assessment.attribution: The credited names include foundational blockade theory and leading experimental realization of programmable arrays.
assessment.maturity: The platform has progressed rapidly to independently demonstrated many-body simulation and logical-control capabilities.
uncertainties: It remains uncertain whether computation-specific claims have reached the long-term maturity expected for a prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magic-angle graphene exposed a striking route to flat bands, strong correlations, and tunable quantum phases in engineered materials.
assessment.attribution: Bistritzer and MacDonald provided the pivotal theoretical mechanism, and Jarillo-Herrero led the transformative experimental discovery.
assessment.maturity: The central flat-band phenomena have been widely reproduced and extended to many moiré systems.
uncertainties: The universality and microscopic interpretation of all correlated phases remain actively debated.
